VERIFICATION RECORD
19 October 2026

Lean: leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0
Mathlib: 56a005855ea17e0b0958f73ec801ae140b0a1679

Historical smooth-branch verification (19 October 2026)
------------------------------------------------------
bash scripts/check.sh passes with 9103 Lake jobs, auditing 194 project and
555 vendor declarations. Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur.
New proofs cover the exact principal-plane Hilbert function, sharp polynomial
section/Bézout bounds, singular-plane-point counts below the characteristic,
and independent spanning-row selection. Further checked proofs establish
integer column-lattice factorization, residue-block determinant and maximal-
minor-gcd aggregation, finite polynomial Newton approximation on actual smooth
plane residue classes, the local triangular valuation bound, the actual smooth
reduction partition, and the resulting global logarithmic gcd estimate with
explicit finite-field point-count and excluded-prime inputs. The generic filtered-space and point
separation lemmas were adapted from the author's Pierce-length development;
their copyright and Apache license headers are retained.

The full PlaneCurveBound and AffineCurveBound are still unproved. In particular,
the singular local curve determinant estimates, finite-field point estimate,
bad-prime control, auxiliary degree bound and controlled projection are not
certified by this build.

The branch proves the complete monomial indexing, exact homogeneous Hilbert

integrated-build counts above; integration is checked separately.

Singular plane local determinant, direct verification (19 October 2026)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Eight new modules were compiled sequentially with the pinned toolchain and both
-DautoImplicit=false and -DwarningAsError=true:
  SingularTangent, OriginLayerGenerators, OriginTruncationGenerators,
  ModularPolynomialLift, ModularOriginGenerators, SingularApproximation,
  SingularLocalDeterminant, SingularPlaneChart.
Result: PASS, no diagnostics. A separate module-indexed transitive axiom audit
checked all 37 declarations from these modules; only propext, Classical.choice
and Quot.sound occur. Source scan found no sorry/admit/custom axioms.
The theorem singular_plane_residue_minorGcd gives actual evaluation-matrix
maximal-minor divisibility by p raised to the sum of the local exponents
sum_{i<s} floor(i/mu). The input multiplicities are orders of the actual
translated mod-p equation, not assumed local-ring generators or determinant
factorizations. Integer generators and uniform approximation at all actual
curve zeros are constructed in the proof. Translation handles arbitrary
integral representatives, and the existing block theorem combines classes.
This closes the singular plane local-algebra step; the sharp finite-field point
bound with multiplicity, coefficient-controlled bad primes, auxiliary-degree
threshold/nonmultiple argument and controlled projection remain open. The
general higher-dimensional hypersurface local theorem is not asserted.
The preceding integrated-build record is historical. These direct checks do
not assert a new full repository build; root imports and integration are
verified separately.

Actual all-point residue partition, direct verification (19 October 2026)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
PlaneMultiplicity and SingularReduction also compile with
-DautoImplicit=false and -DwarningAsError=true. The expanded transitive axiom
audit covers all 61 declarations from the ten singular-branch modules and
passes with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
The final theorem singular_reduction_minorGcd constructs positive total residue
multiplicity M and an exponent e satisfying s^2 <= 2*M*(e+s),
s^2/(2*M)-s <= e, and p^e dividing the actual maximal-minor gcd. It requires
only a prime p, a nonzero equation modulo p, a nonempty list of actual integral
zeros, and arbitrary integer polynomial evaluation columns. The entire
residue partition and all multiplicities are derived. It also bounds M between
the number of reduced points and degree times that number. The sharp bound
M <= p + C(d)*sqrt(p) is still unproved; the elementary upper bound recorded
here does not replace that missing result.
PlaneMultiplicitySmooth additionally derives the singularity of multiplicity
at least two and bounds total multiplicity by the actual point count plus
d^2(d-1) for irreducible reductions below the characteristic. Its strict
direct compile passes. The sharp point-count estimate remains open.
Final import for this branch: AffineCurveCounting.PlaneMultiplicitySmooth.

Global singular determinant assembly, direct verification (19 October 2026)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
SingularDeterminant compiles with -DautoImplicit=false and
-DwarningAsError=true. A module-indexed transitive axiom audit passes all four
new declarations with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
The local card-bound theorem uses actual integral zeros, an irreducible
reduction and p greater than the original degree; positivity of the reduced
degree is derived. The exact global theorem sums log(p) divided by the actual
point count plus d^2(d-1). The prime-sum theorem additionally assumes the sharp
finite-field point bound and supplies the explicit excluded-prime charge and
error (C+d^2(d-1))*primeErrorMass. Smoothness and assumed local divisibilities
are absent. Sharp finite-field counts, effective bad-prime control and the
cutoff optimization for CCDN's degree dependence remain open. This is a direct
module check, not a new integrated repository build.

Fourth-power prime cutoff, direct verification (19 October 2026)
----------------------------------------------------------------
PrimeCutoff and SingularDeterminantCutoff compile with
-DautoImplicit=false and -DwarningAsError=true. A module-indexed transitive
axiom audit passes all 20 declarations (including generated exports), with only
propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Source scanning finds no sorry/admit,
custom axioms, native_decide or implemented_by. The two modules contain 394 lines.
The proof derives a uniform prime-weighted O(L^(-1/2)) tail from factor-four
Mertens blocks. The actual singular determinant theorem at L=27*d^4 and x=s is
  log minorGcd >= s^2/2 * (log s - 4*log d - badPrimeCharge - K(C)),
where K(C) is independent of degree. The local divisibilities, partition,
singular correction and cutoff optimization are proved. Sharp finite-field
point counts and good-reduction hypotheses are explicit, and their effective
geometric proofs remain open. Final import: SingularDeterminantCutoff.
This records direct module checks; the integrated repository build is recorded
separately. Historical records above are retained unchanged.

and ShearNormalization are integrated and built with autoImplicit=false and

with logarithmic witness height 27*d^4*(1+2*log(H)/d²) and the corresponding
prime-charge estimate. Integer shears preserve irreducibility and total
degree, commute with coefficient maps, and preserve the actual bad-prime set.

equation. The transformed-coefficient height estimate remains unproved, so
the uniform bad-prime charge in arbitrary coordinates is not yet discharged.

General plane bad reduction and auxiliary degrees (19 October 2026)
------------------------------------------------------------------
ShearHeight, GeneralBadReduction, PlaneBadPrimes, HeightDeterminant and
PlaneChartHeight are integrated. The shear height is at most H*(d+1)^(d+2).
For arbitrary absolutely irreducible integer plane equations, the actual
finite bad-prime set above 27*d^4 is constructed and its charge is bounded
by log(1+log(H)/d²)+log 7+2*mertensError+1. The determinant comparison now
uses this proved charge instead of assuming a bad-prime estimate.
PlaneAuxiliaryDegree, PlaneAuxiliaryLargeHeight and PlaneAuxiliarySelection
are also integrated. They choose integer degrees and construct actual
homogeneous integer nonmultiples in both height ranges, retaining the
B^(2/d) and L^(-1/d²) factors in the small-height case. The large-height
bound is (34+8*exp(K+6+T))*d^3, with explicit positioning loss T.
All eight modules passed direct Lean checks with autoImplicit=false and
warningAsError=true. The integrated bash scripts/check.sh passes with
9157 Lake jobs. The transitive audit checks 602 project and 555 vendored
declarations, allowing only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

assume the sharp finite-field point-count estimate; coefficient positioning,

Primitive models, homogeneous charts and Bezout counts (19 October 2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
PrimitiveIntegerPolynomial, PrimitiveNormalization, HomogeneousChart and
PlaneAuxiliaryCount are integrated. Every nonzero rational multivariate
equation has a primitive integer model differing by a nonzero rational scalar.
Degree and homogeneous grading are preserved; integer content removal does
not increase coefficient height. Divisibility over Q reflects to integer
divisibility for any primitive equation, without an irreducibility assumption.
The x0=1 chart is injective in each homogeneous degree, and bounded
homogenization inverts it. Full chart degree lifts affine divisibility to
homogeneous divisibility. Consequently the actual integer auxiliary
nonmultiples produce proper rational affine sections. Bezout now gives
finite-family and actual integer-box count bounds in both height ranges.
The four modules pass direct Lean checks with autoImplicit=false and
warningAsError=true. The integrated bash scripts/check.sh passes with
9161 Lake jobs. Its transitive audit checks 650 project and 555 vendored
declarations, allowing only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
Source checks verify 25 vendor hashes and 111 reachable mathematical modules.
These totals precede the coefficient-position integration below. The resulting point bounds still
assume sharp finite-field counting and the stated height/position conditions.
The small-height exponent remains 2/d. Coordinate positioning and the affine
scaling/prime-selection argument needed for exponent 1/d remain open, as do
controlled projection, non-geometrically-integral cases and Pierce geometry.
The full curve-counting theorem is unproved. No independent human review is asserted.

Bounded coefficient positioning (19 October 2026)
-------------------------------------------------
IntegerGridInterpolation, PlaneGridHeight, HomogeneousTranslation,
HomogeneousLeadingCoefficient, HomogeneousEvaluationHeight,
LeadingPositionHeight and AffineTranslation are integrated. Integer-grid
interpolation gives coefficient factors (d+1)^(d+1) and (d+1)^(2(d+1)) in
one and two variables. A nonzero grid value is turned into the actual
lexicographic leading coefficient by a homogeneous integer translation.
The translation preserves primitivity, homogeneous degree, chart degree and
irreducibility under coefficient maps. Parameters lie in 0,...,d, and the
integer-point radius grows by at most d+1. The actual transformed chart
coefficients are bounded by H=P(d)*L, where
  P(d)=(d+1)^(4(d+1))*(d+2)^2*(2d+1)^d.
For d>=1, H>=1 and log L<=log H<=log L+14d². Thus the coefficient-position
input now has a proof; its final combination with the count branches and
height elimination is still to be assembled.
All seven modules pass direct Lean checks with autoImplicit=false and
warningAsError=true. The integrated bash scripts/check.sh passes with
9168 Lake jobs. The transitive audit checks 705 project and 555 vendored
declarations, allowing only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
Source checks verify 25 vendor hashes and 118 reachable mathematical modules.
These totals precede the scaled-model integration below. The full finite-field point count,
affine scaling/prime selection, controlled projection, non-geometrically-
integral cases and separate Pierce geometry remain unfinished. No counting
axiom or independent human review is asserted.

Scaled models, affine exponent and scaling-prime construction (19 October 2026)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Thirteen modules are now integrated: PolynomialMapDeterminant,
PolynomialMapAuxiliary, ScaledHomogenization, ScaledHomogenizationPrimitive,
HomogeneousSlice, ScaledAuxiliaryCount, ScaledHeightElimination,
ScaledModelPosition, ScaledModelCoordinates, ScaledPlaneCount,
ScaledBoxExponent, ScalingPrime and ScaledPlaneSmallCoefficient.
The determinant and auxiliary-degree constructions now accept polynomial
homogeneous-coordinate maps of the original integer curve. The scaled model
satisfies F_p(p,x)=p^d*f(x), retains original coefficients in absolute value,
and has a coefficient at least p^d. It is primitive for prime p not dividing
f(0). Divisibility reflection on x0=p gives proper rational sections and the
actual Bezout bound. Bounded translation supplies point radius (d+1)B and
H>=p^d with log L<=log H<=log L+14d². The monotone logarithmic-height ratio
eliminates H. Both auxiliary branches yield an actual finite-family count
  t <= K(C,A)*d^3*B^(1/d)*(log B+d),
where K is explicit and independent of the equation coefficients, provided
B/A<=p<=B, p does not divide f(0), and the sharp finite-field bound holds.
The first Mertens estimate and prime-divisor charge now construct such a
prime with A=exp(2*mertensError+2) when B>=A, f(0)!=0 and log|f(0)|<B/A.
The resulting point bound in that branch has no prime-existence assumption.
All thirteen modules pass direct Lean checks with autoImplicit=false and
warningAsError=true. The first eleven were also integrated and fully checked
with 9179 Lake jobs and 766 project declarations. After the prime-selection
integration, bash scripts/check.sh passes with 9181 Lake jobs and a transitive
audit of 774 project and 555 vendored declarations. Only propext,
Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur. Source checks verify 25 vendor hashes
and 131 reachable mathematical modules. These totals precede the complete
affine plane assembly below.
The complementary large-height case, zero constant terms and small boxes in
the affine count assembly remain open. The sharp finite-field estimate,
controlled projections, non-geometrically-integral cases and separate Pierce
geometry remain open. Neither PlaneCurveBound nor AffineCurveBound is proved.
No counting axiom or independent human review is asserted.

Complete affine plane assembly, conditional on sharp residues (19 October 2026)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Six modules are now integrated: UnscaledModelCount, AffineBoxRanges,
AffineNonzeroConstant, AffineTranslationCount, AffinePlaneAssembly and
RationalPlaneAssembly. The unit-scaled model is primitive and transfers
auxiliary nonmultiples to proper sections. It gives a coefficient-uniform
2/d fallback and an O(d^4) count from a sufficiently large actual coefficient.
The numerical box split is proved at B=(12A)^2*d^2. Above it, B/A is large
enough for the large-height branch; below it, the fallback has an absolute
d^4 bound. The Mertens scaling-prime branch and these bounds cover every
B>=1 for equations with nonzero constant term.
A bounded integer translation now removes that restriction, preserving
primitivity, degree, irreducibility and residue counts via an actual
ZMod p equivalence. Its radius cost satisfies
  curveBound(d,(d+1)B) <= 2e*curveBound(d,B).
The primitive integer theorem therefore has no coefficient-height,
prime-existence, constant-term or box-range restrictions beyond B>=1.
Primitive rational normalization extends it to all absolutely irreducible
rational plane equations with one explicit constant independent of degree
and coefficients. The only counting input is SharpPlaneResidueBound C,
explicitly defined as a proposition and still unproved. The result does not
assert PlaneCurveBound or AffineCurveBound.
All six modules pass direct Lean checks with autoImplicit=false and
warningAsError=true. The integrated bash scripts/check.sh passes with
9187 Lake jobs and a transitive audit of 815 project and 555 vendored
declarations. Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur. Source
checks verify 25 vendor hashes and 137 reachable mathematical modules.
These totals precede the nonabsolute integration below. The sharp finite-field estimate,
rational irreducible but not absolutely irreducible case, controlled
projections, arbitrary-curve degree interfaces and separate Pierce geometry
remain unfinished. No counting axiom or independent human review is asserted.

Nonabsolute curves and the exact plane target (19 October 2026)
--------------------------------------------------------------
PolynomialLinearDescent, NonabsolutePlaneCount, PlaneCurveAssembly and
GeometricResidueReduction are integrated. A nonzero polynomial over a field
extension descends, using a linear functional on its coefficients, to a
nonzero base-field polynomial of no greater total degree which retains all
base-field zeros. For a base-field irreducible equation f that factors into
two nonunits over an extension, its base-field points split between those
factors. The descended sections are proper since each degree is below deg f.
Bezout bounds the two subsets by d*deg g and d*deg h, giving at most d^2
points in total. This theorem holds over arbitrary fields and extensions;
no Galois action or smooth-point descent is assumed.
The rational nonabsolute case is therefore bounded in every box independently
of its radius. PlaneCurveAssembly proves the exact PlaneCurveBound target
from SharpPlaneResidueBound C with C>=0. GeometricResidueReduction applies
the d^2 bound to nongeometric finite-field curves and handles degree drops
under reduction. Thus SharpGeometricPlaneResidueBound C implies the full
rational plane-count target. The geometric sharp estimate remains unproved.
All four modules pass direct Lean checks with autoImplicit=false and
warningAsError=true. The integrated bash scripts/check.sh passes with
9191 Lake jobs, auditing 833 project and 555 vendored declarations. Only
propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur. Source checks verify 25
vendor hashes and 141 reachable mathematical modules. These totals precede the formal-branch integration below. Controlled projections, general-curve degree and
nongeometric interfaces, and the separate Pierce geometry remain unfinished
in addition to the sharp geometric finite-field estimate. There is still no
unconditional proof of PlaneCurveBound or AffineCurveBound. No counting
axiom or independent human review is asserted.

---------------------------------------------------------------
Thirteen modules now pass direct Lean checks with autoImplicit=false and
warningAsError=true: PowerSeriesOrderIndependence, FormalImplicitRoot,

PlaneTangentMultiplicity, PlaneFrobeniusAuxiliary, PlaneFrobeniusSystem and
PlaneStepanovBound. The formal branch is constructed and faithful, proper
sections have order at most d*m, and summed multiplicities satisfy N*#S<=d*m.
Tangent derivatives detect these multiplicities for N<=p. Injective low-degree
jets prevent Frobenius cancellation when d*D<p. A finite linear kernel supplies
actual nontrivial auxiliary coefficients. The final assembled bound is
  #S*N <= d*(D+p*A)+d*(d-1)*N,
under the explicit inequality sum(r<N,H(D+A+r*d))<H(D)*H(A) for the actual
filtered Hilbert dimensions. No formal branch, auxiliary polynomial,
noncancellation assertion or multiplicity estimate is left as an input to this
result. The integer parameter choice giving p+O(d² sqrt(p)) is still unproved.

Sharp finite-field count and unconditional plane theorem (19 October 2026)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
StepanovParameters, PlaneStepanovDimension, StepanovRealBound and SharpPlaneCount
pass direct Lean checks with autoImplicit=false and warningAsError=true.
The integer choices A=floor(sqrt(p)/d), D=floor((p-1)/d), N=d*A-4*d² satisfy the
strict dimension inequality for p>27*d^4. All rounding is accounted for.
The resulting point count is p+161*d²*sqrt(p) for every irreducible prime-field
plane equation. SharpPlaneResidueBound 161 is proved. The theorem
AffineCurveCounting.planeCurveBound proves the exact PlaneCurveBound statement
without an external counting hypothesis. Earlier records of an open finite-field
input or open plane theorem describe historical intermediate stages.
The integrated bash scripts/check.sh passes with 9208 Lake jobs, auditing
917 project and 555 vendored declarations. Only propext, Classical.choice and

mathematical modules. These totals precede the primitive-pair integration below. AffineCurveBound,
controlled projections, general-curve interfaces and separate Pierce geometry

Uniform exceptional count by deformation (19 October 2026)
---------------------------------------------------------
Twelve new modules pass direct Lean checks with autoImplicit=false and
warningAsError=true: PolynomialMatrixSpecialization, PolynomialKernelOrigin,
PolynomialKernelDerivative, PlaneProjectionDerivative, PlaneRelationSpace,
PlaneLinearDeformation, PolynomialCoefficientLinearMap,
PolynomialFamilyRelations, CurveProjectionDeformation,
PlaneDeformationRelation, CurveDerivativeReconstruction and
DegreePreservingProjectionCount.
They construct a nonzero-at-zero family of actual plane relations and derive
polynomial reconstruction with the common denominator f_Y. Its degree is at
most d-1 and it is proper. Every degree-preserving linear projection in the
stated prime-curve setting consequently loses at most d(d-1) points from any
finite set, with no geometric-integrality or exceptional-fiber assumption.
The integrated bash scripts/check.sh passes with 9237 Lake jobs, auditing
1008 project and 555 vendored declarations. Only propext, Classical.choice and
Quot.sound occur. Source checks verify 25 vendor hashes and 187 reachable
mathematical modules. These are the integrated totals for that stage.
Bounded existence of a degree-preserving projection, the full affine counting
assembly and the separate Pierce geometry remain unproved. No counting axiom
or independent human review is asserted.

Bounded degree-preserving projection, direct checks (19 October 2026)
-------------------------------------------------------------------
Twenty-one new modules pass direct compilation with autoImplicit=false and
warningAsError=true. The final theorem exists_bounded_degree_preserving_projection
constructs both moment coordinates, bounded by n²*d and n*d², and an irreducible
plane equation of degree exactly d. exists_bounded_projection_card_le additionally
bounds the loss of points in every finite source set by d(d-1). Infinity
avoidance, the parameter-field embedding and full extension degree are proved,
not assumptions. The proof covers prime curves without geometric integrality.
The integrated bash scripts/check.sh passes with 9258 Lake jobs, auditing
1122 project and 555 vendored declarations. Only propext, Classical.choice and
Quot.sound occur. Source checks verify 25 vendor hashes and 208 reachable
mathematical modules. These are the integrated totals for that stage. The full general
affine counting assembly and separate Pierce geometry remain unfinished.
No counting axiom or independent human review is asserted.


Full affine counting theorem, direct verification (19 October 2026)
------------------------------------------------------------------
DegreePreservingProjectionBox, ProjectionScaleAbsorption, AffineProjectionCount
and AffineCurveBound pass direct compilation with autoImplicit=false and
warningAsError=true. The final declaration is
  AffineCurveCounting.affineCurveBound : AffineCurveBound.
Its target quantifies n>=2, then chooses C(n)>0 before the prime ideal, positive
Hilbert degree and B>=1. The precise bound is C(n)*d³*B^(1/d)*(log B+d).
All counting, projection, height and exceptional-point inputs are proved.
This completes the external theorem's stated prime-ideal/Hilbert-degree
interface; it does not prove the remaining Pierce geometry or final bound.
The integrated bash scripts/check.sh passes with 9262 Lake jobs, auditing
1140 project and 555 vendored declarations. Only propext, Classical.choice and
Quot.sound occur. Source checks verify 25 vendor hashes and 212 reachable
mathematical modules. These are the latest integrated totals. The proof of
AffineCurveBound is complete; no external counting result is assumed.
No independent human review or separate kernel implementation is asserted.
